assumptions: No walk-off (B = 0), no absorption (kappa = 0), waist in the middle of the crystal (mu = 0): the case of the 1.068 / 2.84 optimum.
Low conversion (undepleted pump): 1 pJ in 2 ps through 10 mm.
An ideal dispersion-free crystal: one Sellmeier index for both waves, n = 1.8, with a tiny term that sets Delta k; no group-velocity mismatch over 2 ps.
h is normalised by the 1-D model of the same crystal with a collimated beam of the waist radius, where h = xi exactly.
